_meta.role: Single source of truth for the game catalogue. Powers the game library, the landing-page carousels and the downloadable brochure.
_meta.catalogue: 30 entries: 26 named titles plus 4 unnamed teaser slots. 10 Origins (7 released, 3 upcoming) and 16 Classic. `WS.query()` drops the 4 teasers, so the library and brochure show 26.
_meta.wp_mapping: Each entry becomes one 'game' custom post. See wp/HANDOVER.md for the field-by-field ACF mapping.
_meta.specs_source: Every figure on the site is transcribed from one of three documents; none is invented except where noted. ORIGINS (10 titles, 7 released): spec blocks, stories, core features and buy options from A4-wildsheep-ORIGINS_20260820.pdf. CLASSIC (16 titles): twelve spec panels from A4-wildsheep-classic.pdf, which carries no prose at all; the six Joker Win Hits titles additionally carry hit frequencies and feature blocks from 'Wild Sheep Joker Win Hits Series.pdf', which is also the only source for Megaways, Win Boost and Win Stepper. Fields no brochure carries (`game_id`, `free_spin_cost`, `symbols`, `_meta.platforms`) come from the Techtoniq asset packs and apply to Origins only. `epic-stars` appears in no document and is the single entry still on placeholder figures — it carries `specs_provisional: true`.
_meta.spec_vocabularies: The two ranges describe themselves differently and the schema keeps both rather than forcing one. ORIGINS uses `layout` (Grid Layout, '6x4') + `mechanic` (Win Mechanic, '4096 ways') + `hit_rate`/`feature_hit_rate`. CLASSIC uses `reels` (Game Type, '6 reels') + `lines` (Lines, '4,096 ways') + `region` + `orientation`, and states no hit frequencies. Every key is in the game page's SPEC_LABELS and each game renders only the keys it carries.
_meta.detail_blocks: The game page renders these optional per-game blocks, each independently: `tagline_lines`, `options` (a string, or `{label, available:false}` for an option the game lacks), `story` (array of paragraphs), `features` (`{title, body[]}`), `symbols` (`{name, file, note?}`, with optional `symbols_title` / `symbols_lead` overriding the section heading and adding a lead), `screenshots` (`{file, caption, w, h}` — the pixel dimensions are required so the browser reserves the right box before load and so a portrait capture is never cropped to landscape), `buy_options` (`{title, body, cost?, symbol?}`), `platform` (a key into `_meta.platforms`), `demo_url` and `art` (`logo`, `backdrop`, `cast[]`). Omit a block and its section is skipped. `specs_provisional: true` prints the placeholder-specification note inside the spec band.
_meta.release_dates: Release dates for the seven ORIGINS-brochure titles encode the brochure page ORDER (earlier page = more recent), which is all the brochure states. The dates themselves are inferred. Upcoming dates are the brochure's months, day set to the 1st.
_meta.inferred_dates: Release dates for joker-win-hits-megaways, -win-boost and -win-stepper are inferred from their order in Wild Sheep Joker Win Hits Series.pdf, on the same monthly cadence the rest of the Joker entries use. The deck states no dates. They were re-dated on 2026-08-26 from 2026-05/06/07 to 2025-11-12, 2025-12-10 and 2026-01-14 so that the whole CLASSIC range sorts below the whole ORIGINS range: the old dates interleaved three Classic titles through the Origins run and put two of them in the library grid's promoted top four. No document states any release date in this catalogue, so the ordering is the only thing these values carry — and Classic predates Origins.

techtoniq.note: Distribution reach quoted on the Origins marketing sheets. Identical across all seven, so it is stored once and referenced by each game's `platform` key rather than repeated.

_meta.normalised_values: Two source documents spell the same volatility level differently — the brochures write 'Medium-high', the Joker Win Hits deck writes 'Medium/High'. Normalised to 'Medium-high' (7 entries vs 3) on 2026-08-26 so the field is a single closed set: it is orthography, not a figure, and two spellings would become two options in one ACF Select. Also on that date, epic-stars' min/max bet were given the € symbol and the catalogue's number format — that entry appears in no document and its figures are invented placeholders (specs_provisional). STILL INCONSISTENT, deliberately left alone: feature_hit_rate runs '1 in 149' on the six Joker titles and '1/273' on Origins, again tracking the two documents. Both notations are readable, they never appear side by side, and neither becomes a Select.

source_conflicts.bamboonanza.features: A4-wildsheep-ORIGINS_20260820.pdf p7 gives Bamboonanza's Core Features as 'Expanding Grid' and 'Multiplier Totem' — which is Iron Gate's copy (p19), and contradicts Bamboonanza's OWN spec block on the facing page: an expanding grid is incompatible with 'Grid Layout 5x6' and 'Win Mechanic 50 Lines'. The same error is in the Techtoniq deck the brochure was built from, so it is an upstream content bug, not a transcription slip. The features shipped here come from Bamboonanza's own Feature Symbols slides instead. Flag to Techtoniq; a re-import from either document brings the wrong copy back.
source_conflicts.spin-my-drink.hit_rate: A4-wildsheep-ORIGINS_20260820.pdf p8 prints '48,5%' with a comma where every other figure in the document uses a point. Normalised to 48.5%.
source_conflicts.iron-gate.buy_options: A4-wildsheep-ORIGINS_20260820.pdf p19 titles the last tier 'ULTIMATE BONUS GAMES' but describes it as 'Direct access to the Ultimate Free Spins feature'. Kept verbatim.
source_conflicts.packs_superseded: Where the Techtoniq .pptx sheets disagree with the brochure, the brochure wins. They disagree on: Blob Invasion's RTP bands (packs show one band at 94.3%, brochure three at 94.0/96.0/98.2), Cursed's RTPs (94.5/96.0 vs 94.58/96.06), Bamboonanza's volatility and hit rate (Very High, 19.38% vs High, 27.1%), Spin My Drink's mechanic and max bet (Mini Game, €100 vs Hi-Lo, €2000), and High Roller's Cash's grid (1x4 vs 4x1).
source_conflicts.classic_normalisations: A4-wildsheep-classic.pdf writes the same value two ways across its own pages: '4096 ways' (p3, p4) and '4,096 ways' (p13), 'Pay anywhere' (p5, p11) and 'Pay Anywhere' (p6). Normalised to the separated/title-case form. Bets are printed '0.10 €' and are stored '€0.10' to match the rest of the catalogue; Stallion Stampede's capped figure '250,000x bet / 288,271 €' is kept whole as '250,000x bet / €288,271'.
source_conflicts.joker_series_vs_classic_brochure: Wild Sheep Joker Win Hits Series.pdf (created 2026-02-17) disagrees with A4-wildsheep-classic.pdf (2026-07-26) on three figures. The A4 brochure is five months newer and its values are the ones shipped: joker-win-hits volatility A4 'Medium-high' vs deck 'High'; joker-win-hits-power-5 max win A4 '5,000x bet' vs deck '10,000x'; joker-win-hits-power-5 volatility A4 'High' vs deck 'Medium/High' (its RTP also reads 95.01% vs a rounded 95%). Worth confirming with the studio — the max-win gap is a factor of two.
source_conflicts.joker_series_placeholder_text: Pages 9, 11 and 13 of Wild Sheep Joker Win Hits Series.pdf carry a leftover Fishin' Frenzy strapline ('Collect enough fisherman... the BIG CATCH... 50x bet') sitting underneath the real panels, where it is hidden by the artwork on screen but present in the text layer. It is placeholder residue from the template and is not used.

games.title: Blob Invasion
games.tagline: The invasion spreads. So do the wins.
games.summary: A chain-reaction grid collector with frequent hits and flexible bonus-buy options, built to keep players engaged and revenue growing.
games.card_line: A failed experiment is loose on the ship, and every blob it touches pays.
story: A drifting spaceship has been overrun by mysterious Blobs created by a failed space experiment. As the Blobs spread through the ship, they connect, multiply, and trigger chain reactions within its systems. The further the invasion grows, the more unstable — and rewarding — the journey becomes.

games.title: Iron Gate
games.tagline: Hold the gate. Take the hoard.
games.summary: A siege-themed cascade slot on a grid that grows as you win: every cascade adds a row, up to 8 rows and 262,144 ways, while the Multiplier Totem climbs through three stages.
games.card_line: Hold the gate and the grid grows with you — one new row for every wave.
story: Irongate — an ancient fortress built to contain immense power. Each breach weakens its defences, unleashing energy that reshapes the battlefield. As pressure mounts, the gate shifts and expands until it finally fails, releasing everything it was meant to hold.
Wins cascade across an ever-growing grid as the Multiplier Totem charges with every breach — driving the action toward explosive rewards.

features.title: Expanding Grid
body: The grid grows by one row with each winning cascade, up to a maximum of 8 rows — increasing winning potential and feature impact with every expansion.

features.title: Multiplier Totem
body: The Totem advances through three stages, with multiplier values rising at each stage.
The active multiplier applies to all wins within the round, then resets before the next begins.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.note: Substitutes for all symbols except Bonus, Upgrade and Multiplier symbols.

symbols.name: Bonus
symbols.note: When a Bonus symbol reaches the leftmost reel, 7 Free Spins are awarded.

symbols.name: Multiplier
symbols.note: On reaching the leftmost reel or the bottom of the grid, increases the active multiplier and transforms into a Wild.

symbols.name: Upgrade
symbols.note: On reaching the leftmost reel or the bottom of the grid, advances the Multiplier Totem by one stage and transforms into a Wild.

buy_options.title: Boost Bet

buy_options.title: Upgrade
buy_options.body: Starts a single game round with the Multiplier Totem at Stage 3.

buy_options.title: Multiplier Wild
buy_options.body: Enables Multiplier symbols to activate on reaching the leftmost reel or the bottom of the grid.

buy_options.title: Buy Free Spins

buy_options.title: Ultimate Bonus Games
buy_options.body: Direct access to the Ultimate Free Spins feature.

games.title: Cursed
games.tagline: Some wins come with a price.
games.summary: A haunted-halls cascading slot on 46,656 ways, built around the Wicked Reel above the grid, feeding sticky wilds, win multipliers and row replacements into a 25,000x top end.
games.card_line: A wicked reel hangs over the grid, feeding it wilds that refuse to leave.
story: Decades ago, a shattered séance tore the veil between worlds — and what should have been sealed was left open. The restless dead are bound to these halls. The night here is endless. Only Annie brings respite.

Where she appears, the Specters withdraw — then gather again, fusing into something worse. The PA crackles. Seals on the doors glow with the promise of escape. That promise is a lie. Beyond each threshold lies only deeper darkness. In the eternal seventh hour, awareness is the only light. Let it fade, and the night claims everything.

features.title: Wicked Reel
body: The Wicked Reel is positioned above the grid and consists of three rows.
It contains Feature Symbols, blank symbols and empty cells; blank symbols occupy positions only.
Feature symbols become active when they enter the grid.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.note: Substitutes for any paying symbol except Specters. A win of Wilds alone pays as the highest-paying regular symbol.

symbols.name: Bonus
symbols.note: Three or more anywhere on the grid trigger Free Spins.

symbols.name: Annie
symbols.note: Where she appears the Specters withdraw — named in the game’s own background story.

buy_options.title: Big Symbol
buy_options.body: Activate a single game round with at least one Big Symbol guaranteed to enter the grid and the Wicked Reel.

buy_options.title: Annie's Spell
buy_options.body: Activate a single game round with Annie's Spell guaranteed.

buy_options.body: Allows direct access to the Free Spins feature.

buy_options.title: Ultimate Free Spins
buy_options.body: Direct access to Ultimate Free Spins, where the win multiplier starts at x10.

games.title: Spin My Drink!
games.tagline: One spin. One round. On the house.
games.summary: A Hi-Lo mini-game at 97.01% RTP with seconds-long rounds, where players pick the bottle each round — switchable across six house labels without touching the maths.
games.card_line: Call it high or low, pick your poison, and it's settled in seconds.

features.title: Rapid Rounds. Real Wins.
body: Lightning-fast spins with instant outcomes drive bet frequency and session engagement.
No waiting — players stay in the loop, generating higher volume per session.

features.title: What will your drinks be?
body: Picking any drink you want for each round creates perceived control and emotional investment.
This ritual deepens retention and reduces churn through habit formation.

features.title: Operator Advantages
body: Velocity plus personalisation means higher session value and improved player lifetime value.
Frictionless mechanics meet psychological stickiness.

games.symbols_lead: The game supports switching between six house bottle labels. The change is cosmetic — the maths, RTP and hit frequency are unaffected.

games.title: The Void
games.tagline: Stare long enough and it pays back.
games.summary: A Lovecraftian 4,096-ways slot with two separate bonus games, where Collect symbols sweep the value of every Cash and Jackpot symbol on the reels.
games.card_line: Stare into it long enough and it starts handing back everything on the reels.
story: In the stygian dark, the forests of New England stir around a colossal behemoth — trembling, squirming with unholy life, unhallowed flames flicker as wild drums pound a sonata of madness.

Acolytes of a forbidden cult dance and chant in rabid fervor, offering living flesh to call forth those abhorrent entities whose very glance condemns mortal men to eternal lunacy or instant oblivion: the Great Old Ones, who once ruled the cosmos for a trillion trillion years uncounted.
The Old Ones were. The Old Ones are. The Old Ones shall be.

features.title: Collect Feature
body: Triggered when a Collect Symbol appears anywhere on the reels.
Each Collect Symbol collects the values of all Cash and Jackpot Symbols currently on the reels.
Cash, Jackpot and Collect Symbols do not appear in Call Of The Void.

symbols.name: Collect
symbols.note: Collects the values of all Cash and Jackpot symbols on the reels.

buy_options.title: Buy Bonus Game 2

buy_options.title: Buy Bonus Game 3

games.title: High Roller's Cash
games.tagline: Play like the house always paid.
games.summary: A single-line, four-reel cash game where reel 4 unlocks with the stake — Reward Multipliers, a Respin and the Lucky Wheel are all gated behind bet level.
games.card_line: Raise the stake and a fourth reel opens up. Play like the house always paid.

features.title: Reward Multiplier
body: Reward Multiplier symbols (2x / 5x / 10x) land only on the special reel 4 and boost that spin's line win.
Payout = number-symbol combination × Reward Multiplier.

features.title: Scatter
body: Scatter lands only on reel 4 and launches the Lucky Wheel.
Lucky Wheel Bonus = total bet × the multiplier landed on the wheel. Payout = number-symbol combination + Lucky Wheel Bonus.

features.title: Respin
body: The Respin symbol appears only on reel 4. Landing it re-spins reels 1, 2 and 3.
Payout = number-symbol combination + the combination produced by the respin.

features.title: Feature Unlocks by Bet Level
body: Reel 4's features activate progressively with the player's stake. While a feature is locked, its position on reel 4 displays a padlock symbol.
Higher stakes also raise the Lucky Wheel's top prize tiers.

symbols.name: Scatter
symbols.note: Lands only on reel 4 and launches the Lucky Wheel.

symbols.name: Respin
symbols.note: Appears only on reel 4 and re-spins reels 1, 2 and 3.

games.title: Joker Win Hits
games.tagline: The joker never misses twice.

games.card_line: The one that started it all: fruit, fire, and a joker that pays on sight.

features.title: Base Game
body: 3x3 win lines with four fixed pots ranging from 25x to 1000x base stake. Cash symbols are active on reels 1&3 and will be awarded when a Joker Collect symbol lands in view on reel 2.

features.title: Joker Win Hits Bonus
body: Achieving a Cash symbol on reels 1&3 with a Joker Collect symbol on reel 2 activates the feature round. You have 3 respins to land any coins on reels 1 & 3. Each time a new coin lands in view, it is collected by the Joker collect symbol on the centre reel, resetting the Spins Remaining to 3. This continues until all spins are used.

features.title: Joker Win Hits Feature
body: Every spin a Cash or Joker collect symbol lands in view, it is added to the Cash Blast meter above the reels. If the Cash Blast feature is triggered, it adds enough cash and collect symbols to the reels to trigger the Joker Win Hits Bonus.

games.title: Joker Win Hits Hotstepper

games.card_line: Every win climbs the ladder. Only a loss cools it back down.

features.title: Joker Win Hits Bonus
body: Achieving a Coin symbol on reels 1&3 with a Joker Win Hits symbol on reel 2 activates Joker Win Hits Bonus. You have 3 respins to land any coins on reels 1 & 3. Each time a new coin lands in view, it is collected by the Joker Win Hits symbol on the centre reel, resetting the Spins Remaining to 3.

games.title: Joker Win Hits Win Stepper
games.tagline: Wins that keep walking down.
games.summary: A Joker Win Hits cabinet where the Win Stepper icon marches every coin value down a position and collects it again, for as long as values stay on the reels.
games.card_line: Each coin marches down a step and gets collected all over again.

features.title: Win Stepper
body: If the Joker Win Hits symbol reveals the special Win Stepper icon, the Win Stepper feature is triggered. Any values in view step down one position. If they remain in view, they are collected again, and so on. New coin symbols can step into view on reels 1 and 3.
Win Stepper continues until no coin values are on the reels.
